zh-TW: 籌資活動的現金流量統計
籌資活動之淨現金流量
en: Net cash from (used in) financing activities

note.zh-TW: 模板原文寫「籌資活動的現金流量統計」，「統計」是「總計」的用詞錯誤；網站顯示修正寫法，模板原字列為別名。
note.en: The template label uses a wrong word for total; the site shows the corrected wording and keeps the original as a searchable alias.

definition.zh-TW: 籌資活動各列的合計。正數表示這段期間從股東與銀行拿進來的錢多於還出去的；新公司成立時通常是大額的正數。
definition.en: The sum of the financing lines. A positive figure means more money came in from shareholders and lenders than went back out; a newly founded company usually shows a large inflow.
